summary: Full frontend E2E test of PSNV-B Einsatzdokumentation Expo web app on mobile viewport (390x844). All 12 requested flows verified: tab navigation, empty state, form filling with Betroffene/Symptome/Massnahmen/Übergabe chips, save-button disabled validation (toast shown when Datum/Stichwort empty), successful save with navigation to /einsatz/[id], detail view with all sections + sticky Export/Print buttons (both tap without crash), delete flow (native confirm accepted), mission list card rendering, Statistik metrics + Stichwort/Symptom bars, Einstellungen prefill into Neuer Einsatz form (Anna Beispiel / ASB), AsyncStorage persistence across page reload.

issues: Console deprecation warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow); props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking but should be cleaned up.

action_items: (Optional) Replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow and move pointerEvents to style to silence RN Web warnings.

(Optional) After save navigates to detail, tapping detail-back returns to the Neuer Einsatz tab (originating route) rather than the Einsätze tab. Consider router.replace('/(tabs)') or navigating to /einsaetze so the user lands on the list where the new card is shown.
critical_code_review_comments: No backend used — pure local (AsyncStorage) app, matches spec.
All interactive elements have proper testID prop; selectors worked reliably.
Save gating (canSave) correctly enforces Datum + Stichwort and surfaces toast.
seed_data_creation: One test mission created via UI (Stichwort: Todesfall im häuslichen Umfeld, 2026-01-15, Max Mustermann/Malteser); deleted at end of test. Settings saved: Anna Beispiel / ASB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is entirely client-side with AsyncStorage. Test URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (https://psnv-print.preview.emergentagent.com). Use mobile viewport 390x844. Delete uses native window.confirm — attach page.once('dialog', lambda d: d.accept()) before clicking detail-delete. PDF export uses expo-print/expo-sharing which may no-op on web preview; only verify tap does not crash.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. All 12 test scenarios passed.
